title: Recipe Scaler with a Judge

topics.name: WEEK 2 - WEEKLY WORKFLOW SHOW-AND-TELL ON YELLOWDIG

content:
My workflow scales recipes and a judge scores each draft out of 10; 8 passes.

I tested the failure path by raising the threshold.

Question for the class: how do you stop a judge from being too generous?

comments.content: Did you try a hard gate on units?
Yes, code now rejects any missing unit.
